WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026: West Bengal Police (WB Police) has invited applications for the engagement of Contractual Drivers under different districts/units of West Bengal Police across the state. Through the recruitment drive, several Driver (Temporary / Contractual Basis) posts will be filled in different district/units including Murshidabad, Bn Barjora Bankura, Bn Barrackpore, Purulia, Murshidabad Police District, Krishnanagar , Hooghly Rural Police District and others. Candidates having Madhyamik with other eligibility can apply for WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026 for the engagement of Contractual Drivers under different districts/units of West Bengal Police. Interested and eligible candidates can apply for these posts as per the notification released for district-wise posts. You are advised to check the notification link for the last date for the concerned districts where you are willing to apply.
WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
Candidates willing to apply for the contractual Driver posts under different districts/units can download the notification pdf which are available with districts wise pdf on the official website of West Bengal Police. The wb police driver recruitment 2026 official website download link is available at https://wbpolice.gov.in. To apply for these positions, you will have to visit the concerned area/zone/units official website and follow the guidelines as mentioned on the official notification.

WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026: Eligibility
The applicant must be a citizen of India and should be a permanent resident of West Bengal to apply for these posts. Apart from this, candidates should have other eligibility including-
Class VIII passed from a recognized School.
